outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: (1) The agent listed three responsibilities instead of exactly two—this exceeds the requirement and doesn’t harm usefulness. (2) Minor phrasing differences in paraphrasing responsibilities/work-site arrangement would be fine, but here they match the page.

Critical issues: (1) The agent did not provide two preferred qualifications, which is an explicitly requested primary deliverable item. The output instead says the preferred-qualification bullets were not readable/visible; however, the provided DOM evidence for the opened listing (states 4–5) does not show a “Preferred Qualifications” heading in-view, so the claim that the heading was visible is not supported by the DOM (a minor accuracy problem), and more importantly the agent failed to extract the required two preferred qualifications.

What was completed successfully: The agent did perform the correct targeted search on Microsoft Careers for “Applied Scientist” with location “Redmond, Washington” (DOM states 3–5 show the query/location parameters). The agent opened a relevant listing (“Applied Scientist II / Senior Applied Scientist - Responsible AI (CoreAI)”) that explicitly includes “United States, Washington, Redmond + 4 more” (DOM states 4–5). It correctly reported the job number (200017828) and work-site arrangement (“3 days / week in-office”), both explicitly shown in the DOM. It also reported at least two responsibilities that are directly supported by the Responsibilities bullets in DOM state 5.

Overall outcome: Despite correctly finding and opening a relevant Redmond-associated Applied Scientist listing and extracting most required details, the agent failed to deliver one of the task’s required outputs (two preferred qualifications). Because that missing element is a hard requirement and part of the primary deliverable, the task is not successfully completed from an average user’s perspective.
outcome.primary_intent: The user wanted the agent to use Microsoft Careers to find and open a relevant “Applied Scientist” job associated with Redmond, WA, then extract and report four specific pieces of information from that single listing: the job number, the work-site arrangement, two key responsibilities, and two preferred qualifications. A reasonable user would be flexible on the exact Applied Scientist level/title variant (e.g., Applied Scientist II/Senior) and “Redmond + other locations” being acceptable as long as Redmond is explicitly included, but would not be flexible on missing any of the requested fields—especially the two preferred qualifications.
